The fix is commit `1c19126f11ca5bb93891bd18d89910d20f41ee84`, "(fix) O3-6097: Fix inverted labels on the free text dosage toggle (#3793)", by Sathieskumar Sudeshkar. It swaps the `labelA` and `labelB` props on the drug order form's toggle so that `labelA` is now `Off` and `labelB` is now `On`. The toggle's `labelA` is shown in the off state and `labelB` in the on state, so the labels now match the switch. The commit also adds a regression test that checks the toggle shows "Off" when unchecked and "On" when checked.

The changed lines in the component are 981-982 (`labelA={t('off', 'Off')}` and `labelB={t('on', 'On')}`) inside the `ControlledFieldInput` toggle branch. The new test is at lines 324-338 of the test file.

I did not run the test suite. The conclusion comes from the commit diff and reading the code at that commit.
